news.headline: Thrive Capital led VCs into pro sports ownership; Collaborative Fund just upped that play
news.summary: Collaborative Fund is betting on sports ownership as a startup showcase, acquiring a stake in D.C. United and its stadium. The move signals growing VC appetite for pro sports as both investment and brand-building platform—following Thrive Capital's earlier pivot into team ownership.

news.headline: Oracle posts 30% revenue growth fueled by AI cloud demand as debts hits $125 billion
news.summary: Oracle's cloud infrastructure business is firing on all cylinders, with revenue up 121% year-over-year as customers rush to tap AI-powered cloud services. The database giant's broader portfolio also accelerated, posting 30% total revenue growth—a sign that AI momentum is lifting the entire company.

educational.title: What Inflation Actually Does to Your Money
points: Inflation means the same dollar buys less over time as prices rise
Cash sitting idle quietly loses purchasing power every year to inflation
This is a core reason people invest rather than just save in cash
Central banks target a small amount of inflation (often ~2%) as "healthy"
Wages that don't keep pace with inflation mean a real pay cut, even if the number goes up
